source.author: verg
source.text: Ei mihi, quantum praesidium Ausonia et quantum tu perdis, Iule!
source.text_original: Ei mihi, quantum / praesidium Ausonia et quantum tu perdis, Iule!'
source.text_english: Alas for me, how great a safeguard do you and Ausonia lose, Iulus!

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: ei mihi, Colchos unde ego et avecti timuissem vellera Phrixi?
reuse.text_original: ei mihi, Colchos / unde ego et avecti timuissem vellera Phrixi?
reuse.text_english: Alas for me, from Colchis, from where would I have feared the fleece of Phrixus, and borne it away?
